RagnarosEmpowerSulfurasSulfurasHungers.name: Sulfuras Hungers
RagnarosEmpowerSulfurasSulfurasHungers.description: Quest: Every time Empower Sulfuras kills a Minion, its damage is increased by 1, up to 25. Reward: After killing 25 Minions, increase its damage by an additional 100.

RagnarosLivingMeteorShiftingMeteor.name: Shifting Meteor
RagnarosLivingMeteorShiftingMeteor.description: Each time an enemy is hit by the same Living Meteor, they take 6% increased damage from it. Quest: Hit 75 Heroes with Living Meteor. Reward: After hitting 75 Heroes with Living Meteor, its duration is increased to 2.25 seconds, and it can be reactivated to change its direction on

RagnarosBlastWaveEngulfingFlame.name: Engulfing Flame
RagnarosBlastWaveEngulfingFlame.description: Increase Blast Wave's damage by 50% and its radius by 15%.

RagnarosLivingMeteorFireWard.name: Fire Ward
RagnarosLivingMeteorFireWard.description: When Living Meteor hits an enemy Hero, gain a charge of Spell Armor, reducing damage from the next enemy ability by 50%. Stores up to 2 charges.

RagnarosBlastWaveSlowBurn.name: Slow Burn
RagnarosBlastWaveSlowBurn.description: Blast Wave Slows enemies hit by 40% for 2 seconds.

RagnarosCatchingFire.name: Catching Fire
RagnarosCatchingFire.description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Ragnaros' Health Regeneration by 1.25 per second, up to 18.75. Reward: After gathering 15 Regeneration Globes, activate Catching Fire to gain 25 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 25%.

RagnarosEmpowerSulfurasHandOfRagnaros.name: Hand of Ragnaros
RagnarosEmpowerSulfurasHandOfRagnaros.description: If Empower Sulfuras hits at least 2 enemy Heroes, refund 10 Mana and its cooldown recharges 100% faster for 4 seconds.

RagnarosLivingMeteorMoltenPower.name: Molten Power
RagnarosLivingMeteorMoltenPower.description: If Living Meteor hits enemy Heroes at least 5 times, reduce its cooldown by 7 seconds, and refund 30 Mana.

RagnarosBlisteringAttacks.name: Blistering Attacks
RagnarosBlisteringAttacks.description: Every 10 seconds, Ragnaros's next Basic Attack against a Hero deals 60% bonus damage. Hitting enemies with Basic Abilities reduces this cooldown by 1 second.

RagnarosSulfurasSmash.name: Sulfuras Smash
RagnarosSulfurasSmash.description: Hurl Sulfuras at the target area, landing after 0.75 seconds, dealing 250 damage. Enemies in the center take 594 damage instead and are Stunned for 0.5 seconds. Quest: Hit 8 enemy Heroes in the center. Mythic Reward: Sulfuras Smash gains an additional charge.

RagnarosLavaWave.name: Lava Wave
RagnarosLavaWave.description: Release a wave of lava from Ragnaros's Core that travels down the targeted lane, dealing 240 damage per second to non-Structure enemies in its path and instantly killing enemy Minions. Damage increased by 100% versus Heroes.

RagnarosEmpowerSulfurasCauterizeWounds.name: Cauterize Wounds
RagnarosEmpowerSulfurasCauterizeWounds.description: Empower Sulfuras heals for an additional 45% of damage dealt to Heroes over 2 seconds.

RagnarosBlastWaveTemperedFlame.name: Tempered Flame
RagnarosBlastWaveTemperedFlame.description: When Blast Wave damages an enemy Hero, gain a Shield equal to 100% of the damage dealt for 3 seconds.

RagnarosResilientFlame.name: Resilient Flame
RagnarosResilientFlame.description: When Ragnaros is Stunned, he gains 40 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 40%. This effect has a 15 second cooldown.

RagnarosEmpowerSulfurasGiantScorcher.name: Giant Scorcher
RagnarosEmpowerSulfurasGiantScorcher.description: Empower Sulfuras burns enemy Heroes for 9% of their maximum Health over 3 seconds. This additional damage does not heal Ragnaros.

RagnarosLivingMeteorMeteorBomb.name: Meteor Bomb
RagnarosLivingMeteorMeteorBomb.description: Living Meteor explodes at the end of its path, dealing 220 damage. Enemies at its center take 30% increased damage.

RagnarosBlastWaveBlastEcho.name: Blast Echo
RagnarosBlastWaveBlastEcho.description: After Blast Wave explodes, another Blast Wave is created on Ragnaros.

RagnarosSulfurasSmashFlamesOfSulfuron.name: Flames of Sulfuron
RagnarosSulfurasSmashFlamesOfSulfuron.description: Sulfuras Smash Slows enemies by 50% for 2.5 seconds, and the Stun duration of enemies hit in the center is increased by 1 second.

RagnarosLavaWaveLavaSurge.name: Lava Surge
RagnarosLavaWaveLavaSurge.description: Lava Wave gains an additional charge and causes allied Minions and non-Boss Mercenaries to be carried with it.

RagnarosMoltenCoreHeroicDifficulty.name: Heroic Difficulty
RagnarosMoltenCoreHeroicDifficulty.description: Molten Core's range is increased by 100% at the start of its duration. In addition, the cooldown of Molten Core is reduced by 110 seconds when used on a destroyed Fort or Keep.

RagnarosSubmerge.name: Submerge
RagnarosSubmerge.description: Ragnaros submerges below, entering Stasis and healing for 600 Health over 3 seconds.
